thread:
incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired: P1 embeddings-queue-high (prod-eu) — 95th latency ~1.2s, 5xx rate ~3.2% — runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/embeddings-queue

alex: taking. grabbing PD console now

pd-bot: PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by alex (alex@redwood)

sam: pinging infra autoscaler, looks like a short burst from a heavy customer job

alex: seeing HPA not scaling fast enough. trying manual scale to buy time

alex: ```kubectl scale deployment/embeddings-worker -n prod-eu --replicas=8```

lee: noted. some requests are hitting the legacy pool's degraded nodes; routing to dedicated pool could help if needed

maria: hey, I'm coming up on shift in ~10m, will take over if still hot. what’s current customer impact?

alex: customer impact: intermittent 5xx on embeddings for EU customers, ~30% of requests affected between T-9m and T-2m. CS has been pinged.

sam: quick note — I pushed a suppressed alert burst to reduce noise (batching enabled) so followups don't flood channel :pray:

alex: mitigation: scaled to 8 replicas, enabled fallback route to v2-fallback model-variant, KV cache warmed. early signs: 5xx down to ~0.8%

maria: copying logs. alex, can you paste the kube output & any errors you saw? Also I'll take ownership in a minute.

alex: kube output: ```deployment.apps/embeddings-worker scaled to 8
WARNING: Pod embedder-3 had OOMKilled earlier, restarted OK
```

lee: filed INF-1423 to follow up on OOM patterns. recommendation: tune HPA target and ramp policy.

pd-bot: PagerDuty: ownership transferred from alex to maria

alex: handoff notes: scaled manually, fallback route enabled, no config changes besides scaling, still watching queue drain.

maria: taking over — monitoring dashboards. queue length is trending down, request latency median improving. I'll keep this until stable for 30m (5xx < 0.1%).

sam: I updated #support with a short PSA: "Investigating intermittent embeddings errors in EU region; mitigation in progress."

maria: nice. planning next steps: revert manual scale to HPA target after stable, add pre-scale hook for deploys, and follow up with CS on customer impact summary.

incidentbot: Incident update: mitigation applied, monitoring for regression. Next scheduled update in 15m.

maria: RESOLVED — root cause: HPA cooldown + unexpected traffic spike causing temporary queue buildup. Impact: degraded embeddings for ~20 min for a subset of EU customers. Follow-ups: INF-1423 (HPA/ramp), INF-1424 (pre-scale hook), CS1 to send customer note.

sam: :thumbsup:

lee: logging runbook changes and adding a test for pre-scale behavior.

alex: thanks all, leaving final notes in the PD incident.
